f2_mapping.core_finding: AgentSight can be evaluated as an independent system witness for process/file/network/resource/tool activity, but must remain noncanonical witness evidence. It may not become UnifiedDB truth, EffectGate/EffectJournal authority, or completion authority.
f2_mapping.provenance_strength: Current snapshot v1 and source model expose view_source/confidence on audit/process/tool rows and tool_call_id/related_pid/related_event_id on tool rows. These are useful foreign-witness fields but not automatically F2 causal identity.
f2_mapping.important_boundary: AgentSight documents view_source as row lineage rather than logical-operation identity and confidence as source-specific rather than a global probability.
f2_mapping.capture_boundary: Live eBPF-backed capture is privilege/platform sensitive; fallback/native-session evidence must never be reclassified as kernel-observed.
f2_mapping.privacy_boundary: Snapshots can contain argv, paths, network destinations, audit details, and tool inputs/outputs; a F2 adapter must minimize/redact fields and bind retention policy.

counterhypotheses: F2-native telemetry may achieve sufficient coverage with lower dependency/privilege/privacy cost.
AgentSight identifiers may not establish exact F2 invocation-to-process/effect bijection.
A narrower deterministic proof-bundle/syscall witness may deliver higher evidence value than the full observability stack.
next_discriminator: EXPERIMENTAL_FALSIFIER: minimal read-only adapter over a pinned AgentSight v1 snapshot fixture with both kernel/view and agent_native_session/fallback provenance; acceptance requires fail-closed schema handling, lossless provenance, no authority promotion, and later F2 overhead/coverage measurements.
